words.gloss_range: complete non-clausal three-letter opener: rootless, untranslated, visually compact, recited as separated letter-names, semantically opaque, and meaningful through opening position, sound, recurrence, and the forward move into book-revelation discourse rather than ordinary lexical predication

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: first recited letter-name in the opener; open initial onset
middle recited letter-name; lateral articulation in the sequence
final recited letter-name; bilabial nasal closure at the sequence end
the following revelation-of-the-Book phrase that fills the opener's forward expectation

words.prose: {{ar:الٓمٓ}} ({{tr:alif lām mīm}}) is a complete ayah made of disconnected letter-names, not a nominal sentence, verbal sentence, governed particle phrase, declined noun, or inflected verb. The reader enters the surah through recited sign-status before ordinary Arabic grammar can assign subject, predicate, case, mood, object, or valency. The surface also makes the language-material visible: before any root or morphology appears, the recitation presents {{ar:ا}} ({{tr:alif}}), {{ar:ل}} ({{tr:lām}}), and {{ar:م}} ({{tr:mīm}}) as names of letters themselves. Its one written cluster is visually compact but audibly unfolded into three weighted beats, so script compresses while recitation separates and prolongs; within that cadence, {{ar:ل}} ({{tr:lām}}) and {{ar:م}} ({{tr:mīm}}) especially give the sequence long, closed-sounding names. Because it gives no lexical proposition, the opener functions by controlled opacity and attention: the reader waits for the first statement rather than decoding a normal word. That delay is not isolated; {{ar:الٓمٓ}} ({{tr:alif lām mīm}}) belongs to the wider disconnected-letter opener system of 14 combinations across 29 surahs and to the ALM family at 2:1, 3:1, 29:1, 30:1, 31:1, and 32:1. The local cluster claim should be kept to recurrence and placement: 32:1 stands as the last listed ALM opener, but the evidence does not require a full compositional theory. The bridge is immediate: the ALM openings are followed by Book statements at 2:1-2, 3:1-2, 29:1-2, 30:1-2, 31:1-2, and here 32:1-2, where {{ar:تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ}} ({{tr:tanzīlu al-kitāb}}) supplies the revelation claim after the letter threshold. As a one-token ayah, the same surface opens and closes the first unit before syntax begins, making 32:2 pragmatically expected rather than syntactically governed. It also classifies the surah launch as a letter-opening, not praise, oath, command, question, or narrative. Sonically, the sequence moves from open onset through lateral articulation to the sealed lips of {{ar:م}} ({{tr:mīm}}), so the mouth itself performs an opening-to-closure threshold. The main payoff is convergence: no clause, no lexical root, alphabetic self-reference, visible compactness, recited expansion, controlled opacity, opener-family recurrence, sound movement, and the immediate Book declaration together make the surah begin from raw letters before revealed discourse is named.

topics.headline: complete before clause grammar
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah as complete by opener sign-status, not as an unfinished clause needing hidden syntax.
topics.reason: The aligned QAC row identifies the surface as disconnected letters with no root, no morphology, no case government, and no predicative relation, while translation support warns against converting it into lexical wording.

topics.headline: letters before morphology
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the recitation citing Arabic's own letter-units before any root-pattern word or lexical proposition appears.
topics.reason: The local form is explicitly rootless and unanalyzed morphologically, so the meaningful material is letter identity and citation rather than derivational family.

topics.headline: withheld proposition creates attention
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the opener's absence of ordinary word meaning as an attention mechanism that delays interpretation until the following revelation statement.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows preserve debated decipherment and non-propositional attention value, and the guardrail evidence supports preserving compression instead of assigning a normal lexical gloss.

topics.headline: one cluster, three weighted names
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the tension between one compact written unit and three separate letter-names made weighty by recitation and cadence.
topics.reason: The QAC row treats the surface as one item but identifies it as letter-names rather than an ordinary word, matching the CRITICAL pressure on visible compression and audible segmentation.

topics.headline: recognized restricted opener system
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the opener as part of a restricted Quranic opening system rather than as ordinary vocabulary or a local oddity.
topics.reason: The row evidence gives the broader distribution of disconnected-letter combinations at surah openings, and the local word is exactly such a surah-initial disconnected-letter sequence.

topics.headline: ALM family endpoint, not full theory
topics.reader_payoff: The reader places 32:1 inside the recurring ALM opener family and notices its endpoint position in the listed sequence, while avoiding a larger compositional claim than the rows prove.
topics.reason: The six ALM references survive as concrete recurrence evidence, but the merged claim's stronger suggestion of compositional grouping is kept as a distributional observation rather than a controlling structural theory.

topics.headline: one-token ayah as threshold
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the first ayah as a sealed pre-clausal threshold whose first function is mode-setting, not immediate assertion.
topics.reason: The whole ayah consists of one disconnected-letter item with no clause attachments, so its structural effect is a complete opening boundary before ordinary syntax begins.

topics.headline: letters cue the Book declaration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader expects the following Book-revelation claim because the ALM opener pattern repeatedly moves from disconnected letters to Book statements (2:1-2; 3:1-2; 29:1-2; 30:1-2; 31:1-2; 32:1-2).
topics.reason: The rows give concrete ALM parallels and the immediate 32:2 pickup by {{ar:تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ}} ({{tr:tanzīlu al-kitāb}}), so the bridge is discourse-level expectation rather than syntactic governance.

topics.headline: open onset to sealed lips
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the non-lexical opener still has bodily shape: articulation moves from opening through lateral movement to bilabial nasal closure.
topics.reason: Because the ayah has no lexical or clausal parse competing for the first event, the phonetic trajectory can survive as a local recitational payoff without becoming a semantic explanation of the letters.

topics.headline: layers converge before revelation content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the opener's effect as cumulative: grammar, form, sound, opacity, distribution, and the 32:2 bridge all push from raw letters toward named revelation.
topics.reason: The synthesis row does not introduce a new ungrounded claim; it gathers the already-supported local mechanisms into one threshold reading.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The whole ayah is an ordered sequence of three separately voiced letter-names; the packet marks it rootless and supplies no focus branch inventory.
baseline_models.mechanism: Recognizable units are present, but no rooted lexeme or predication joins them. The sequence interrupts lexical decoding while preserving sound, order, and expectation.

changed_reading.before: A short word whose meaning should be translated.
changed_reading.after: A deliberate rootless threshold whose first effect is suspended relation rather than lexical definition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The separate letter-names and visible elongation marks make the focus performable in time and breath.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah can be complete as a sounded event even while its composite reference remains unresolved; duration is therefore part of its readable material.

changed_reading.before: A silent cipher on the page.
changed_reading.after: A timed vocal object whose intelligibility begins in articulation, duration, and pause.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Alif, lam, and mim retain distinct identities while their fixed order presents them as one ayah.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus models composition without lexical fusion: separateness and unity coexist, making relation among components more salient than a hidden dictionary gloss.

changed_reading.after: A minimal ordered system in which distinct components jointly hold an open reading-space.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate descent-and-book sequence retroactively locates the rootless letters inside the book's delivery and construction. The focus becomes the first material contact with what descends: voiced and written components before propositional exposition.

activation_trace.role: Delivery from one level to another supplies the movement by which the suspended opening becomes the first received contact of the discourse.
The ordering of letters into a written product identifies bare letter-material as belonging to the book's own construction.

structural_cues: 32:2 immediately names descent and book after the rootless opening.
The focus stands at the boundary before the first lexical sentence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: descent and ordered letter-writing follow immediately. Reader: adjacency is allowed to activate the opening backward as the book's first landing. Alternative: the letters may remain an independent marker merely placed before the declaration.

changed_reading.before: An opaque preface outside the following statement.
changed_reading.after: The descended book first arrives as letter-material, then unfolds as lexical declaration.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence withholds an easy paraphrase just before doubt, fabrication, and truth are staged. Its opacity can therefore function as a provenance stress test: confidence must rest on the source and fit of the ensuing book, not on instant semantic possession.

activation_trace.role: Agitated doubt names the readerly instability that the unexplained sequence can provoke and that the next line explicitly contests.
Fabricated falsehood turns the opening's strangeness into a live source-attribution question rather than a mere decoding puzzle.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the opposing criterion by which the strange opening and following discourse are to be tested.

structural_cues: The denial of doubt follows the letters before any explanation of them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: opacity is followed by doubt and a fabrication-versus-truth dispute. Reader: the placement makes opacity test provenance rather than invalidate it. Alternative: the dispute concerns only the book as a whole and does not recruit the letters.

changed_reading.before: Unexplained letters are evidence of semantic deficiency.
changed_reading.after: Unexplained letters relocate the first test from immediate paraphrase to provenance, coherence, and truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measure, composition, and counting let the three-item opening behave as deliberate compression. A very small, countable surface can be composed to hold a scale much larger than itself.

activation_trace.role: Constriction to a small measure supplies the compression side of the opening's compact form.
Joining one thing to another into a composition makes the three distinct letters a constructed unit rather than residue.
Enumeration foregrounds the opening as a countable three-part arrangement and links small count to the verse's enlarged scale.

structural_cues: 32:5 moves from a day to a thousand years and explicitly invokes counting.
The focus visibly offers three discrete units in a fixed order.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a measured thousand-year scale, composition, and enumeration are supplied. Reader: their scale relation is mapped backward onto the opening's three-unit economy. Alternative: the counting language may remain solely temporal.

changed_reading.before: Brevity is merely lack of recoverable content.
changed_reading.after: Brevity becomes measured compression: a counted composition whose small surface opens onto larger scale.

context_deltas.mechanism: The letters are fully available as visible and audible marks while their combined purport stays concealed. The opening thus enacts an interface between witnessed form and hidden relation rather than occupying only one side.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark that guides makes each recognizable letter informative even without resolving the composite.
Concealment from sight supplies the unresolved relational meaning held behind the manifest letter-forms.
A witnessing sign supplies the publicly present face of the same opening: marks that remain inspectable and recitable.

structural_cues: 32:6 pairs the hidden and the witnessed under knowing.
The focus gives identifiable units but no rooted composite.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: distinguishing marks, concealment, and witnessing signs are juxtaposed. Reader: known components and unknown relation instantiate that split. Alternative: the hidden/witnessed pair may describe divine knowledge without modeling the opening's reception.

changed_reading.before: Opacity is a blank absence of information.
changed_reading.after: Opacity is staged asymmetry: witnessed signs carry a relation that remains hidden.

context_deltas.mechanism: The creation sequence of beginning, completing, breathing life, and furnishing hearing activates the opening as latent vocal matter. Separate glyphs become a living recitation only when breath, duration, and audition assemble them.

activation_trace.role: Inauguration and precedence align the bare letters with a beginning that starts a later process.
Internal straightening and completion supplies the transition from separate material to an articulated whole.
Sending air into something supplies the literal breath mechanism required to voice the prolonged letter-names.
Life borne by spirit gives the material analogy its activation from inert marks to performed utterance.
Auditory perception completes the circuit in which the opening exists as received sound.

structural_cues: 32:7-9 presents an ordered movement from beginning and formation to breath and hearing.
The focus's elongation is unrealized until a reader supplies breath and a hearer receives sound.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: formation, breath, life, and hearing occur in sequence. Reader: that sequence is used as a material analogy for recitation, not as an identity between human creation and text. Alternative: the passage may not comment on vocalization at all.

changed_reading.before: The opening is a static cluster of written signs.
changed_reading.after: The opening is latent vocal matter animated into a temporally extended, hearable event.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later signs are recalled onto the tongue and followed by a sounded fall into prostration. That sequence activates the opening as a performative sign whose work may be to interrupt, sound, and orient the body before it conveys a proposition.

activation_trace.role: Mention running on the tongue supplies the recitational passage from visible sign to voiced remembrance.
A manifest sign legitimizes reading the plainly present letters as signs even when their composite reference is withheld.
A turbulent fall accompanied by sound joins audition to bodily descent and gives the sign an event-like consequence.
Bending and lowering the head supplies the embodied orientation at the end of the sign-response sequence.

structural_cues: 32:15 orders sign, reminder, falling, prostration, and praise as a response sequence.
The focus itself must be sounded and paused over rather than paraphrased syntactically.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: sign, tongued remembrance, sounded falling, and bodily lowering are sequential. Reader: a causal arrow is drawn from encountered sign to recitation and posture. Alternative: only the later full signs, not the opening letters, elicit this response.

changed_reading.before: The letters are failed propositional content.
changed_reading.after: The letters are a performative cue whose sounding can interrupt and orient before proposition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening's three components recur in the context as small grammatical combinations, while later cues name discourse-parts, an opening that begins what follows, and waiting. The unresolved triad can therefore be carried as a reservoir of micro-grammar distributed through the surah rather than expanded once into a secret phrase.

activation_trace.role: The inventory preserves interrogative and adversative am as a grammatical combination of focus components; the actual unrooted am near the start remains a structural cue.
Discourse-parts that regulate wording and measure support treating the separate letters as operative textual components.
A beginning that opens what follows makes the triad a functional aperture rather than a code requiring immediate closure.
Waiting and granting time preserve unresolvedness through the end instead of forcing a single expansion.

structural_cues: The same three consonantal resources recur in unrooted particles such as la in 32:2, am and ma in 32:3, and lamma in 32:24.
The surah closes with reciprocal waiting rather than an explanation of the opening.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: recurrent particles, a grammatical am branch, textual divisions, opening, and waiting are supplied. Reader: their recurrence is treated as combinatorial echo from the focus. Alternative: these are ordinary high-frequency particles and the echo is accidental.

changed_reading.before: The triad is an inert abbreviation to be expanded once.
changed_reading.after: The triad is a small reservoir of grammatical relations repeatedly recombined while final resolution is deferred.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a later numeral activates two nonidentical registers of the same root inventory. It remains anchored to the focus's initial alif and to a branch explicitly identifying alif as a letter; render it as scale wordplay, not as a lexical gloss, calculation, or numerical code.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The first named component of the rootless focus is alif.

activation_trace.role: The alphabet-letter branch directly returns the later alif-root cue to the focus's first named letter.
The thousand as an aggregate of hundreds expands the same cue from one letter-name into a large counted scale.
Enumeration makes the one-to-thousand shift inspectable as a scale operation rather than free association.

changed_reading.before: Alif is only the first of three opaque components.
changed_reading.after: Alif becomes a one-to-many scale hinge: alphabetic unit and thousand-fold aggregate coexist without being collapsed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The shape-to-motion correspondence is reader-supplied and neither etymology nor a claim that letter-forms encode doctrine. It remains anchored in the visible ordered forms and in a context sequence of descent, ascent, sounded falling, and bending; downstream prose should qualify it as a possible visual-kinetic activation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus presents an ordered line of visibly differentiated letter-forms that must also be sounded.

activation_trace.role: Downward arrival supplies the first vector in a backward-read motion pattern attached to the opening forms.
Ascent supplies the counter-vector, preventing the opening's spatial activation from being only a fall.
A fall accompanied by sound links vertical motion specifically to an uttered encounter.
Head-lowering and bending supply the terminal bodily inflection of the motion sequence.

changed_reading.before: The letters form a static horizontal inscription.
changed_reading.after: The opening can be seen and heard as a miniature motion score of arrival, rise, sounded fall, and bending.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain material analogy, not an etymology of the letters. It remains anchored in their compact pre-discursive form and in the packet's driven-water-to-barren-ground-to-growth mechanism; render it as a generative image in which later discourse activates latent capacity, not as a fixed interpretation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Three compact units precede and potentially seed the book's lexical unfolding.

activation_trace.role: Following in one continuous track supplies directed continuity from the compact opening into what grows after it.
Conveying water by irrigation supplies the activating medium in the material analogy.
Ground cut off from vegetation supplies the initial appearance of sterility analogous to unread opacity.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the transition from latent capacity to manifest reading.
Germination and growth supply the outcome in which later discourse makes the compact beginning semantically productive.

changed_reading.before: The rootless fragment is sterile because it has no lexical yield by itself.
changed_reading.after: The fragment is a seed-like packet whose latent readings emerge as the following discourse irrigates it.

strongest_changes: Immediate descent and letter-writing move the opening from an external cipher to the book's first delivered material.
Measure, composition, and counting recast extreme brevity as deliberate three-part compression.
Hidden and witnessed cues turn opacity into an interface between manifest signs and concealed relation.
Breath, hearing, and embodied response make the ayah a performed event rather than failed proposition.
summary.what_was_special: Because the focus has no rooted morphemes or branch inventory, activation came from its material facts: named letters, fixed order, elongation, separateness, and position. Later branches did not settle one gloss; they generated concurrent textual, epistemic, scalar, vocal, grammatical, kinetic, and ecological readings.
remaining_uncertainties: No branch citation originates in the focus, so every delta is contextual and retroactive rather than a root-derived lexical claim.
The micro-grammar, alif-scale, motion, and seed readings depend on controlled analogy or wordplay and should remain visibly qualified.
Later context can demonstrate productive activation but cannot by itself establish intended authorship-level encoding or choose one final interpretation.

channel_generated_outputs.usage: External source manifest only. These generated outputs may inform channel-family/path context when the agent has file access, but first-pass review limits still apply: no established channel name, accept/reject claim, or maturity claim unless a future adjudicated ledger is present.

unresolved.reason: no compatible span in the best ordered source alignment

morphemes_tsv.note: ayah attribution taken from qac_ref, with non-surah rows and standalone basmala ayah marker rows (1:0) filtered out | dropped_preface_rows=7

word_morpheme_spans.note: Ordered surface alignment within canonical QAC words; only spans shared by all best alignments are joined. Upstream word-analysis identities and wording are preserved. Unresolved analytic units remain available for qualified reading; never infer their QAC identity from upstream numbering.

word_analysis_qac_alignment.note: aligned_qac_word_ref resolves against qac_morphemes for this ayah

channel_review.note: first-pass blind review by a single reader; no adjudication, no accept/reject, no per-ayah channel maturity. Not a channel ledger.

channel_generated_outputs.note: Generated network-v3 channel discovery/family/path outputs are available as external quran-data files; read them only when channel detail is necessary, and do not treat them as an adjudicated channel ledger.

full_context_packet.note: surah-scope fallback: the default commentary workflow does not consume per-ayah focus packets, so the source packet is scoped by this builder to roots this ayah can justify and carries no staged reveal order

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. This ayah has QAC morpheme rows but no lexical roots, so the surah-scope branch inventory has no ayah root to retain. The empty scoped inventory is deliberate for rootless units such as muqatta'at, not a missing source.

v12_reader_responses.note: Per-ayah focus-run reader responses are retired from the default commentary workflow. Use regular reader walks, plus/minus-5 reader walks, and cross-run publication findings for corpus-wide reader-derived evidence.

reader_a.note: reader_s032_a_ayah_walk.md found but zero ayah headings recognised (unrecognised format)

v12_cross_run_publication.note: Compact final cross-run findings for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader runs; use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose.

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained. Dictionary/gloss branches are kept in full for every included Furuq root target.

branch_policy.note: No branch filtering is applied. Every branch present in each included dictionary/gloss root entry is kept.

root_mapping.policy: Use the dominant Furuq root for every QAC root, and include non-dominant Furuq targets as additional root_lexicon entries when qac-furuq-v4-root-map marks the QAC root as split.

root_lexicon.note: Turkish is the only language with dictionary entries/glosses currently sourced.
